title_en: Solar Panels Floating on Reservoirs Could Power Millions of Homes
title_zh: 水庫上的浮動太陽能板可為數百萬戶家庭供電

sentences.en: Scientists found a smart way to make clean energy.
sentences.zh: 科學家找到了一種製造潔淨能源的聰明方法。

sentences.en: They put solar panels on top of water in reservoirs.
sentences.zh: 他們將太陽能板放置在水庫的水面上。

sentences.en: The cool water keeps the panels from getting too hot.
sentences.zh: 涼爽的水能防止太陽能板變得過熱。

sentences.en: This helps them make more electricity and saves land for farming.
sentences.zh: 這有助於它們產生更多電力，並為農業節省土地。

sentences.en: Floating solar farms are becoming a popular solution for clean electricity.
sentences.zh: 浮動式太陽能發電場正成為潔淨電力的熱門解決方案。

sentences.en: By placing panels on man-made reservoirs, countries can save valuable land.
sentences.zh: 透過將太陽能板放置在人工水庫上，各國可以節省寶貴的土地。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the panels reduce water evaporation during hot summer months.
sentences.zh: 此外，這些太陽能板還能減少炎熱夏季期間的水分蒸發。

sentences.en: Researchers estimate this technology could supply power to millions of households worldwide.
sentences.zh: 研究人員估計，這項技術可以為全球數百萬戶家庭提供電力。

sentences.en: Deploying floating photovoltaic systems on existing reservoirs offers a dual environmental benefit.
sentences.zh: 在現有水庫上部署浮動式太陽能光電系統能帶來雙重的環境效益。

sentences.en: Not only does it generate renewable energy without competing for agricultural land, but it also curbs water loss.
sentences.zh: 它不僅能在不與農地競爭的情況下產生再生能源，還能抑制水資源流失。

sentences.en: The cooling effect of the water underneath significantly boosts the efficiency of the solar cells.
sentences.zh: 下方水體的冷卻效應顯著提升了太陽能電池的轉換效率。

sentences.en: Experts believe scaling up this infrastructure is crucial for meeting global carbon neutrality targets.
sentences.zh: 專家認為，擴大這項基礎設施的規模對於實現全球碳中和目標至關重要。
